research_question: Can causal short-horizon obstacle prediction improve dynamic-obstacle Direct Local MAPPO?
main_variable: predictive local observation and predictive risk-aware target scheduling
algorithm: Direct Local Adaptive Edge-GAT MAPPO with causal obstacle prediction
information_boundary: prediction uses current measured relative position and relative velocity only
constant-velocity extrapolation is not given the simulator next state
drift uncertainty is a fixed registered model parameter
allocator emits targets only; actions remain policy outputs

evaluation.success_gate: three-seed mean on fixed dynamic validation must be >= 0.85; otherwise report gate failure
